chunks: And man enquires: "What has come over it?"

key_terms.لَهَا: To it / For it (referring to the earth or the event)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'What has come over it?' mean in Surah Al-Zalzalah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse captures the moment of existential reckoning where the human soul, overwhelmed by the cosmic upheaval of Qiyamah, questions the source of the divine wrath. It highlights the transition from worldly ignorance to acute awareness, serving as a precursor to the detailed account of deeds in the subsequent verses. The disorientation reflects not just confusion, but the dawning realization of individual accountability before Allah.
